_verification_hooks.description: Additional verification scripts that can be installed for enhanced verification

scripts.verify-requirements.sh: Run during Phase 1 to verify requirements completeness
scripts.detect-contradictions.sh: Run during Phase 1 to detect requirement contradictions
scripts.quick-verification.sh: Run on every file edit (type check, lint, quick tests)
scripts.run-mutation-tests.sh: Run during Phase 7 for mutation testing
scripts.run-fuzzer.sh: Run during Phase 7 for fuzz testing

_verification_hooks.installation: Copy scripts from plugin's scripts/ directory to $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/
